notes: Corpus fixture, MUST FAIL under @2. The record claims bootstrap_exception: true — that it read startability from the operator-approved closed-set state packet rather than from the unhardened tools — but carries no State Packet Approval. Without the conditional this validates, and bootstrap_exception becomes a permission the record grants itself, which is the self-certification shape ADR-0028 exists to forbid. Note the fixture DOES carry a different, valid approval type, so a validator cannot pass it by merely checking that approvals is non-empty. All SHAs here are synthetic: a fictional slice record must not pin a real commit of this repository, or a later reader can mistake the fixture for a record. This case extends the five named in M3-PLAN §2 N1; it is here because @2 introduces the conditional and an unfalsified conditional is not evidence (spec §4).
